scope_note.zh: 范围为官方托管语言模型目录中的两个当前主入口，以及官方明确的旧别名和已退役接入名；不把展示的模型版本号或开源权重名猜成可调用API ID。目录可用性是官方文档状态，不保证任意账户当前有权限或服务容量。
scope_note.en: Covers the two current hosted language-model entry points, explicitly documented legacy aliases, and retired API names. Displayed model versions and open-weight names are not invented API IDs. Availability is a documentation state, not proof of current account access or service capacity.
